prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: interior decorating mood board for a real small Brooklyn apartment Halloween party with a total decor budget of $1000. Create a beautifully composed landscape editorial mood board with three distinct material stories labeled exactly 'OCTOBER GROVE', 'THE HOLLOW', 'MOON WELL'. Grove: olive moss mats, dark green hanging ivy, a few russet leaves, bare brown branches, small pumpkins, faux weathered stones, a handmade round glowing moon, dim violet wash and warm fairy light pinpoints. Hollow: tactile BLACK PLUSH STRETCH VELVET purchased as raw yardage, simple clipped top edges, shallow folds covering every wall and windows; violet, deep red and blue LED wash; a simple handmade woodland guardian with glowing amber eyes and dark twig face. Moon Well: green shower fabric, small moon lamp, warm portable lamp and restrained moss along dry edges. Include small atmospheric room vignettes and large realistic material swatches. Rich intimate eerie forest mood, attainable DIY apartment decor, matte black and moss green with restrained amber and violet. Avoid luxury production, lasers, smoke, suspended heavy branches, costly built scenery, extra text, logos, human DJs or people. Concepts only, not a measured floor plan. High quality tactile photographic collage.
prompts.note: Initial room-vignette board excluded; selected materials-only board has separate prompt file.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: illustrative realistic apartment decor concept, wide landscape. Primary request: show an achievable Halloween 'October Grove' inside a modest awkwardly shaped open living dining kitchen apartment at night, warm laminate floor, ordinary white kitchen cabinetry and modern furniture still visible under DIY scenery. View from kitchen toward living space. Sofa close to a TV at the left with a narrow clear walking passage in front. A LOW rectangular coffee table occupies the former dining area with four mismatched dining chairs around it; no dining height table. Keep a broad clear central standing area. Dark green ivy trails along wall tops and window edges, a few brown branches and russet leaves, little faux stones and pumpkins. Kitchen counters in foreground broadly covered with removable moss mats, clean raised serving trays integrated into moss, sink and stove clear and uncovered. Gold tree floor lamp glowing violet, large lightweight handmade luminous round moon on far wall over a small shrine cabinet, broad dim purple room wash and a few warm fairy light pinpoints. Small raven, owl, stag, hare and fox figures and handmade twig guardians placed on dry stable surfaces as a scavenger game. Forest feeling without building actual trees. Realistic restrained $1000 whole-apartment DIY budget, no fog or lasers, no artificial grass on floor, no heavy overhead branches, no candles with real flames, no people. Atmospheric but enough light to recognize furniture and safe clear floor. Not a claim of exact scanned architecture. No text or labels.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: illustrative interior decor concept for small bedroom used as a Halloween techno dance cave. Landscape image, camera from entrance toward far right corner, believable compact room about 9 feet wide and 13 feet deep, ceiling 9 feet 5 inches. ALL walls and tall windows fully masked by raw black plush velvet yardage with shallow folds, simple top clips, not purchased curtains. At rear RIGHT CORNER, an upright bed stored on its long edge occupies about 15 inches depth against rear closet wall, fully hidden with black fabric; the rest of bed is NOT visible. In front a handmade eerie woodland guardian with antler-like branches and two steady glowing amber eyes is the PRETEND DJ. A small ordinary desk only 49 inches wide by 29.5 deep stands in front of guardian, automated laptop/audio gear and two small speakers directly ON desk. No human DJ and no large speaker stands. Guardian has twig mask, draped black body on independent compact support, subtle violet and red light on body. Pair of inexpensive LED PAR lights on perimeter illuminate fabric in low red violet blue, plausible sound-reactive atmosphere, no lasers, strobe streaks or smoke. Keep left side route and substantial front dance floor EMPTY; space feels intimate for 5 to 8 dancers, not a huge club. Two small flat handmade twig charms on wall at reachable height, no extra furniture. Lamp light reveals soft pile texture. Attainable DIY apartment installation, no expensive staging. No text, no people. Illustrative mood concept, not a measured architectural render.
